translation: In the heat of summer and autumn, children have diarrhea, and whether just recovered or not, the whole mouth develops gan erosion, sometimes blocking the throat and endangering life. This is all because dampness prevails within and generates heat; the hot qi steams and scorches so fluids are not produced, and damp-heat injures the qi aspect in a one-sided way. Treat the upper burner, or assist with bland percolation. The common custom is to scrape watermelon rind (xigua cuiyi) to treat gan, taking advantage of its light, floating, percolating, and draining nature.

In summer, damp-heat stagnates and steams, the qi of the spleen and stomach weakens, the qi of water and grain does not move, dampness adheres and accumulates within to become heat, gradually reaching edema and abdominal distension, with difficult urination. If treated contrary to the method, the water-dampness soaks for a long time and flows retrograde to invade the lung, inevitably producing cough and rapid breathing; in severe cases one cannot lie down when sitting, nor look up when bent forward, and the danger comes quickly.
